name: presyowatch-web
description: Dashboard for PresyoWatch. Static export; talks to the API from the browser.
_overridesNote: postcss is pinned forward because Next 14 pulls an older one that carries three advisories (CSS stringify XSS, source-map file disclosure). npm's suggested fix is Next 16, a major upgrade this dashboard does not otherwise need. postcss only runs at build time over CSS committed to this repository, but a known-high advisory in a lockfile is not something to leave unexplained.
